name: REVERSE CRUNCHES
introduce: Lie on your back with your knees up at a 90 degree angle and your hands behind your head. \n\nLift your upper body and thighs, and then stretch out. Repeat this exercise.

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Try to touch your knees to your nose.
Don't bring your elbows to your knees.
Don't pull your lower back up off the floor.
Put your hands behind your ears, don't interlock your fingers.
Lift your shoulders as you exhale and lower them as you inhale.
You shouldn't feel too  much strain in your neck.
This really targets your lower abdominals.
